problem: Users have many strategies available and may not know where to begin or how to return to a useful previous test
purpose: Unify the discovery and retrieval of backtests in one screen

areas.name: Histórico
areas.behavior: Lists backtests previously run by the user

areas.name: Favoritos
areas.behavior: Keeps selected backtests easy to retrieve

areas.name: Score de Backtest
areas.behavior: Assigns a score so two backtests can be compared objectively
